items.title: Bank of America (BAC) Stock Could Stay Reasonable Despite Fresh AI Expansion News
items.summary: Bank of America stock has more than doubled over the past three years, yet current valuation checks still point to a discount relative to an intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model and to what earnings multiples imply. The share price has returned 111.1% over three years, which puts fresh focus on whether recent gains already reflect the underlying value of Bank of America. AI adoption across its operations and client services can support expectations for profitability,...

items.title: Cigna Reports Earnings Thursday With New CEO, New Business Model
items.summary: Cigna Group will report its earnings on Thursday under its new chief executive, Brian Evanko. It’s transitioning its pharmacy benefits business to a rebate-free model.

items.title: Bank Stocks Drop From Record Highs Ahead of Fed Meeting
items.summary: Goldman’s stock, which fell 4.6%, was on track for its worst performance in two months.  Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, and Bank of America—all of which hit records this month, too—dropped 3.4%, 2.3%, and 1.2%, respectively on Wednesday.  Citi was down 3.3%, and Wells Fargo dropped 2%.

items.title: Bank of America vs American Express: Only One Financial Stock Deserves Your Money
items.summary: Bank of America and American Express both crushed Q2 earnings, but the market rewarded only one of them while punishing the other. The gap between their stories reveals something important about where financial stocks are actually headed.

items.title: JPMorgan's Robust Capital Position Fuels Higher Shareholder Returns
items.summary: JPM plans a 10% dividend hike and authorizes a new $50 billion buyback, led by record earnings, excess capital and a resilient balance sheet.

items.title: How the Ultra-Rich Are Borrowing Millions Against Stock Instead of Selling—and Saving on Taxes
